sourceValidation: An actual ExaminationEngagement owner must exist for plan.ExaminationId.
TypeIBaseline must be an exact frozen baseline for same next examination, with exact approved source set and completeness.
TypeIOutcome must be recorded auditor outcome for that exact Type I baseline/examination.
Approved SystemDescription version must be bound to same examination and baseline.
Only then can a TypeIIPlan be proposed/reviewed/approved and period started.
state.availableCreateOwnerCommand: CreateExaminationEngagement(TenantId, ProgramId, ExaminationId, EngagementType, AuditFirm, PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, TrustServicesCategories, BoundaryId, ManagementContactMemberIds)
state.userScope: The approved rollover proposal must pin the exact successor examination identity and period dates; a process may not choose a new ExaminationId after independent rollover approval.

decision.instructions: What is the sound boundary for the missing successor examination/Type I prerequisites?

criteria.pin_next_exam_and_wait: Add NextExaminationId to approved ProgramRolloverContent. Process waits for an actual examination owner and exact completed Type I baseline, auditor outcome and approved bound system-description facts for that identity before accepting a successor plan; plan content binds those exact source IDs/hashes and same exam/date. Do not bypass existing owner workflows.
criteria.process_choose_exam: Let process or plan author choose an examination ID after rollover approval.
criteria.rollover_owns_typei: Put examination, baseline, audit outcome and system-description lifecycles inside ProgramRollover.
criteria.unfinished: The exact prerequisite source workflow or identity policy is not established.

missing.instructions: Is successor ExaminationId an essential missing identity in the currently selected rollover proposal if this same process is expected to create the next TypeIIPlan?

criteria.true: Next plan route and source validation require a concrete examination identity which the rollover currently does not pin.
criteria.false: It is already uniquely derivable from approved rollover content.

order.instructions: What order is required before the next TypeIIPlan can be proposed?

criteria.examination_typei_sources_first: Create successor ExaminationEngagement; freeze its exact Type I baseline; record auditor outcome and approve/bind system description for same exam/baseline; then author/validate TypeIIPlan; then review/approve; then start period.
criteria.typeii_plan_first: Create plan first and later backfill the examination sources.
criteria.parallel_claim: Plan and Type I prerequisites may proceed independently without exact association.

owner.instructions: Where do Type I baseline, audit outcome and system description lifecycles belong?

criteria.their_existing_owners: Each existing examination, baseline, outcome and system-description owner retains its own author/approval authority; rollover process only coordinates actual proofs.
criteria.process_owner: Private process becomes authoritative owner for those business facts.
